design.source_policy: same restricted metadata source admission, exclude 444 previous source hashes and paths, 36 new copy examples and 64 separate crystals; fail closed if reserves insufficient
design.projection: unchanged R118 actual shadow AdamW displacement, eight fresh normalized margin gradients, 24 cyclic halfspace sweeps; scalar clipping to step cap and Euclidean plus weighted ball before actual weight change
design.layer_metric: frozen parent eight constraint gradients per seed; five disjoint groups token/position/block0/block1/final_norm; weight clamp(sqrt(group normalized-gradient RMS/global RMS),0.7,1.4); not individual parameter curvature
design.controls: fixed .50 and fixed .75 Euclidean bounds; all arms clip, use same projection and curriculum/replay schedule; adaptive begins .50 with both Euclidean and weighted constraint, staged expansion .625 then .75
design.expansion: only propose when unbounded projected step crosses current cap, >=5 accepted updates since last expansion, >=5% gate CE improvement since last expansion; commit expanded cap only with unchanged exact semantic veto and additional current-state CE gain >=1e-7; otherwise rollback weights and optimizer, retain old cap
design.retention: unchanged old parent-correct pair/open, 16 historical witnesses, parent CE guard, exact item veto and final held-out exam; zero step not accepted
design.additional_metric_work: one common parent constraint set per seed; scalar arithmetic and layer norms differ by arm; elapsed time recorded
design.decision: report exact answer count, pair and open old loss separately, acceptance, zero steps, boundary/clipping/geometry veto counts, committed cap transitions and per-layer movement; no promotion based on acceptance only

limits: Expansion alters research geometry only, hard step cap .07 and absolute cap .75, not authorization of production expansion
Adaptive arm combines group weighting and staged expansion, cannot attribute effect to one alone; fixed arms also introduce clipping compared with R118
Layer sensitivity estimated from eight parent margins, not all knowledge or per-parameter sensitivity; metric remains frozen
Exact internal gate cannot guarantee held-out retention; no independently administered blind exam
Different new sources and seeds; causal comparison only within same R119 seed
Shared historical document cohorts and derived numeric metadata; not verified scientific claims
No production mutation, promotion, export, or additional autonomy
